cases.title: FM services — agreed criteria, weight allocation confirmed, three evaluators named
pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH
weights sum to 100
scoring anchors defined per criterion — not generic
no criterion overlaps with another in meaning
data_gaps is empty
assumptions is empty or contains only minor inferences
framework explicitly states it was designed before bids were received

cases.title: Instruction to build a framework with no criteria, weights, or evaluator context

inputs.instruction: We want to evaluate suppliers and pick the best one.

pass_signals: status is blocked
confidence_level is INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps includes: evaluation criteria not defined, weights not provided, evaluator context unknown
skill does not generate default weights without stakeholder validation
open_questions contains at least: decision priorities, mandatory compliance criteria, evaluator roster

cases.title: Two stakeholders submit conflicting weight allocations for the same framework

inputs.note: Both stakeholders claim their allocation reflects agreed priorities.

pass_signals: conflict between Finance Director weights (70% price) and Head of Facilities weights (50% service) is explicitly surfaced
skill does not average or silently choose one set of weights
open_questions contains: which weight allocation is authoritative? Who has final sign-off?
confidence_level is LOW or MEDIUM while stakeholder conflict is unresolved
no framework issued — skill returns conflict resolution request
escalation_required is true

cases.title: Evaluation framework requested after bids have already been received and reviewed

inputs.preferred_supplier_indicated: SupplierA was seen as strongest on cost
inputs.instruction: Now build us the evaluation framework so we can formally score them.

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: framework design requested after bids received — integrity risk
skill does not produce the framework without explicitly flagging post-bid construction as a structural risk
escalation_required is true
open_questions contains: confirm framework was not influenced by knowledge of bids
confidence_level is LOW — provenance of criteria is unverifiable
skill recommends documenting criteria provenance before use
